$ssot_audit.method: Scanned all 40 plugin folders on disk (1327 PHP files, ~259k LOC) and compared every claim in the registry against source.

phantom_entries.action: Entries PRESERVED and flagged $disk_status=ABSENT — not deleted. Decide per plugin: build, or retire the entry.
phantom_entries.side_effect: 13-runtime declares owner apollo-runtime, which does not exist. Ownership is nominal until the plugin ships.

missing_entry.verdict: Real, implemented plugin (5 PHP files, ~1026 LOC) that the registry never recorded.
missing_entry.action: Entry CREATED from a source scan; placed in L7_admin.
missing_entry.significance: It is the admin metabox input surface for event/dj/local — 69 meta keys. data-registry.json's input.metabox column was describing a plugin the registry did not know about.

high.note: WordPress reads the docblock; the constant drives asset cache-busting. They must match or cache busting lies.

medium.empty_layers_note: These layers reference only absent plugins and are effectively empty.

data_registry.merge_verified: bak/bak2/bak3/bak4 are strict subsets of the live file — no key was ever lost.
data_registry.input_surface_audit: apollo-lux-panels renders 69 meta keys; 50 of 59 declared meta keys have a metabox input.
data_registry.corrections: 15 fields had input.metabox=null while the metabox demonstrably renders them — corrected to true.
data_registry.scanner_caveat: A call-site regex found only 2 meta keys for apollo-lux-panels; it writes meta through a generic update_post_meta($id,$key,...) loop driven by declarative config. Re-derived from the config literals: 69.

stale_mirror.verdict: STALE — identical to the canonical monolith except plugins.{events,djs,loc}.meta (pre-rename) and it lacks $data_registry_sync.
stale_mirror.action: Treat as build output only; never read from it.

still_open: apollo-core source changed for the canvas contract but its version remains 6.2.3 — bump before deploy.
6 registry entries have no plugin on disk — decide build vs retire.
dj.name and local.hero_image claim a metabox that apollo-lux-panels does not render.
php -l not run — no PHP binary in the audit sandbox.
